title: Descarte de impressoras, multifuncionais e toners
custom_excerpt: Coleta de impressoras, multifuncionais, scanners, toners e suprimentos com avaliação de volume, armazenamento interno e logística.
meta_title: Descarte de impressoras e toners | Coleta Ecobraz
meta_description: Solicite coleta de impressoras, multifuncionais, scanners, toners e suprimentos. Avaliação para empresas, lotes e equipamentos desmobilizados.
html:
Equipamentos de impressão também são ativos eletrônicos

Impressoras e multifuncionais combinam placas, motores, cabos, plásticos, metais e consumíveis. Alguns modelos armazenam documentos, históricos de uso ou credenciais de rede, por isso o descarte corporativo deve considerar dados e suprimentos residuais.

Materiais atendidos

  • Impressoras laser, jato de tinta, térmicas e matriciais;
  • Multifuncionais, copiadoras, scanners e plotters;
  • Toners, cartuchos, cilindros e peças;
  • Fontes, cabos, bandejas e acessórios;
  • Lotes de equipamentos de escritórios e parques de impressão.

O que informar

Envie modelos, quantidades, fotos, endereço e indique se existem toners instalados, equipamentos de grande porte ou restrições para movimentação. Para multifuncionais com armazenamento, informe o requisito de dados.

Perguntas frequentes

Toner pode ser misturado aos equipamentos?

A forma de acondicionamento depende do estado e do tipo de suprimento. A equipe orienta a separação após analisar a solicitação.

Vocês retiram copiadoras pesadas?

A viabilidade depende de peso, acesso, escadas, elevadores e recursos necessários para movimentação.

Solicitar coleta de impressoras

Da solicitação pontual ao fluxo controlado

Empresas com geração contínua, manutenção de parques tecnológicos ou múltiplas unidades podem precisar de um modelo programado, com critérios de acionamento, responsabilidades e dados padronizados.

Aplicações

  • Redes de lojas, escritórios e unidades operacionais;
  • Empresas de tecnologia e telecom;
  • Hospitais, laboratórios e instituições de ensino;
  • Indústrias e centros de distribuição;
  • Programas internos de coleta;
  • Renovação periódica de ativos.

Estrutura comercial

O modelo pode considerar periodicidade, consolidação de volumes, cobertura, responsáveis, documentos e níveis de serviço. A contratação é definida após análise da operação.

Solicitar análise para coleta recorrente.

title: Documentação e rastreabilidade no descarte eletrônico
custom_excerpt: Registros vinculados ao fluxo real da coleta e ao serviço efetivamente executado.
meta_title: Documentação e rastreabilidade no descarte eletrônico
meta_description: Entenda como a Ecobraz estrutura registros, cadeia de custódia e documentação para operações de descarte eletrônico.
html:
Documento sem vínculo operacional é evidência fraca

A documentação precisa refletir materiais, participantes, datas, movimentações e o serviço efetivamente realizado. Modelos genéricos não substituem registros proporcionais ao risco e ao escopo.

Possíveis componentes

  • Registros da solicitação e da avaliação;
  • Identificação da retirada e do recebimento;
  • Inventários ou listas de ativos, quando contratados;
  • Manifestos e documentos aplicáveis à movimentação;
  • Registros relacionados a tratamento de mídias;
  • Documentação de destinação compatível com a operação.

A disponibilidade de cada documento depende do material, da localidade, do serviço contratado e das exigências aplicáveis.

Solicitar coleta com necessidade documental.

title: Logística reversa de eletrônicos para empresas
custom_excerpt: Planejamento de coleta, movimentação e encaminhamento de materiais eletroeletrônicos.
meta_title: Logística reversa de eletrônicos para empresas
meta_description: Logística reversa empresarial para retirada e encaminhamento técnico de equipamentos e resíduos eletroeletrônicos.
html:
Logística reversa não é apenas transporte

Uma operação defensável precisa conectar gerador, materiais, local de retirada, movimentação, recebimento e encaminhamento. A coleta deve nascer com escopo e responsabilidades definidos.

Informações necessárias

  • Localidade e condições de acesso;
  • Tipos e quantidades de materiais;
  • Peso ou volume estimado;
  • Necessidades de inventário e acondicionamento;
  • Restrições de horário, segurança ou documentação;
  • Periodicidade da geração.

A viabilidade e as condições comerciais são determinadas após avaliação dos dados da operação.

Solicitar avaliação logística.

title: Destruição e sanitização de dados em equipamentos descartados
custom_excerpt: Fluxos específicos para mídias e ativos que podem conter informações corporativas ou dados pessoais.
meta_title: Destruição e sanitização de dados em equipamentos descartados
meta_description: Estruture o descarte de HDs, SSDs, servidores e equipamentos com dados por meio de um fluxo técnico e documentado.
html:
O risco permanece dentro do equipamento

A retirada de um ativo de TI não elimina os dados armazenados. Formatação simples, exclusão de arquivos ou restauração de fábrica podem ser insuficientes conforme o tipo de mídia, o risco e a política interna da organização.

O escopo deve ser definido antes da coleta

A Ecobraz avalia o tipo de equipamento, a mídia, a necessidade de inventário, o método solicitado e os registros esperados. A técnica aplicável depende do material e das condições contratadas.

Aplicações comuns

  • Desmobilização de parques de informática;
  • Substituição de servidores e storages;
  • Equipamentos danificados ou fora de garantia;
  • Mídias com dados pessoais ou informações confidenciais;
  • Projetos de encerramento, mudança ou consolidação de unidades.

Solicitar avaliação do descarte de dados.

title: Descarte corporativo de equipamentos de TI
custom_excerpt: Coleta e tratamento de ativos de TI com atenção à cadeia de custódia, dados e documentação.
meta_title: Descarte corporativo de equipamentos de TI
meta_description: Solicite coleta corporativa de computadores, servidores, rede, telecom e outros ativos de TI com rastreabilidade operacional.
html:
Equipamentos de TI não são apenas sucata

Computadores, notebooks, servidores, storages, switches, roteadores e mídias podem carregar dados, credenciais, propriedade intelectual e registros internos. Por isso, o descarte corporativo exige um fluxo distinto de uma retirada comum.

Materiais atendidos

  • Computadores, notebooks e monitores;
  • Servidores, storages e equipamentos de data center;
  • Rede, telecom e segurança eletrônica;
  • Impressoras, scanners e periféricos;
  • Cabos, fontes, placas e componentes;
  • Mídias e dispositivos de armazenamento.

Definição do escopo

A operação pode incluir inventário, identificação, segregação, retirada, transporte, descaracterização e tratamento de mídias, conforme a necessidade e a proposta aprovada.

Solicitar avaliação empresarial.

Esta página reunirá documentos, registros, publicações, licenças, referências públicas e critérios operacionais que permitam verificar a atuação da Ecobraz sem depender de alegações promocionais.

Camadas de evidência

  • Identidade jurídica e canais oficiais;
  • Licenças e registros aplicáveis;

Os documentos serão publicados somente após validação de vigência, escopo e autorização de exposição.

title: Sobre a Ecobraz
custom_excerpt: Execução operacional brasileira em logística reversa, descarte técnico de eletrônicos, rastreabilidade e documentação.
meta_title: Sobre a Ecobraz
meta_description: Conheça a Ecobraz Emigre, sua atuação no descarte técnico de eletrônicos, logística reversa, rastreabilidade e documentação operacional.
html:
Execução operacional com responsabilidade

A Ecobraz Emigre atua na coleta, triagem, processamento e encaminhamento de resíduos eletroeletrônicos, atendendo empresas, instituições e geradores que precisam estruturar o descarte de forma técnica e documentada.

O trabalho parte de uma premissa objetiva: retirar fisicamente um equipamento não encerra, por si só, os riscos ambientais, documentais, operacionais ou de dados associados ao material.

O que a Ecobraz entrega

  • Avaliação técnica e logística da solicitação;
  • Coleta conforme localidade, materiais e volume;
  • Fluxos específicos para equipamentos de TI e mídias;
  • Registros e documentação compatíveis com o serviço contratado;
  • Rastreabilidade operacional aplicável ao escopo realizado.

Critério antes de promessa

A Ecobraz não promete risco zero, aceitação automática de documentos ou conformidade universal. Cada operação possui escopo, limitações e requisitos próprios. Nosso compromisso é documentar o que foi efetivamente contratado e executado.

Solicite uma avaliação de coleta.

Débora Villanova, Comercial. Copie a assinatura daqui e cole no Gmail — leva menos de um minuto e não precisa baixar nada.

Como vai aparecer no fim dos e-mails

Débora Villanova
Comercial
•  (11) 4329-2001
•  debora@ecobraz.org.br

Colar no Gmail

  1. 1

    Clique em Copiar assinatura, aqui em cima.

  2. 2

    No Gmail, abra a engrenagem ⚙ no canto superior direito → Ver todas as configurações → aba Geral → role até Assinatura → Criar (dê um nome, por exemplo “Ecobraz”).

  3. 3

    Clique dentro da caixa branca da assinatura e cole com Ctrl + V (no Mac, ⌘ + V).

  4. 4

    Logo abaixo, em Padrões da assinatura, escolha essa assinatura nas duas listas — “para novos e-mails” e “ao responder/encaminhar”. Role até o fim da página e clique em Salvar alterações.

Se algo não sair como deveria

Mande um e-mail de teste para você mesma e confira se a logo aparece. Se ela vier quebrada, apague a imagem na caixa da assinatura e use o botão Inserir imagem do Gmail para subir o arquivo da logo. Se o botão de copiar não funcionar no seu navegador, selecione a assinatura com o mouse e use Ctrl+C.

Código HTML da assinatura (para Outlook ou suporte técnico)

A mesma assinatura em código. No Outlook: Arquivo → Opções → E-mail → Assinaturas.

Want to reach Ecobraz? Pick whichever channel suits you — they all reach the same team, and the reply comes within 24 business hours, in English or Portuguese.

Ways to reach us

Request a collection

The fastest route: tell us what you have and where it is — the team confirms everything with you before scheduling.

Go to the request form

WhatsApp

To talk from your phone, ask questions and send photos of what you want to dispose of: open a WhatsApp conversation.

Telephone

Prefer to call and speak to a person? +55 11 4329-2001 (business hours, Brasília time).

E-mail

For messages with attachments, documents and institutional matters: contato@ecobraz.org.br.

What happens after you get in touch

The team replies within 24 business hours, on any channel. For a collection, sending the request does not confirm the pick-up on the spot: the team checks the material and the conditions and agrees everything with you before scheduling. Free collection happens within 1 to 7 business days; need it tomorrow? Express collection within 24 hours costs R$ 55 (Brazilian reais).

Address

Associação Auxílio à Reciclagem de Eletrônicos e Inclusão Digital – Ecobraz
Brazilian company registration (CNPJ) 14.197.457/0001-42
Rua Dona Maria Quedas, 230 — Jardim Andaraí, São Paulo/SP, postcode 02175-010, Brazil.

Quick questions

How much does collection cost?

Collection is free — Ecobraz is paid by the destination and recovery of the material, which is why there is no charge. If your case is not free, we tell you beforehand, with the amount. Need it tomorrow? Express collection within 24 hours costs R$ 55.

Where do you operate?

São Paulo and the surrounding region; corporate operations in other Brazilian regions are assessed case by case. To hand equipment over in person, see the collection points.

We are a company: is the route the same?

Yes — use the same form, indicating that you are a company, or any channel on this page. For the full corporate model, see business e-waste collection and large enterprises and multinationals.

Can you deal with our head office abroad?

Yes. The service is sold and performed in Brazil, and the documentation is built to be read and verified anywhere: the destination certificate carries a QR code, and the portal history is exportable. The team replies in English or Portuguese.

html:
Many sites, a committee that decides together, and an audit that asks for proof — not promises. Ecobraz serves large enterprises and multinationals with documented disposal at scale: a multi-site programme, planned recurrence and a document set per collection, with a certificate whose authenticity any auditor confirms in seconds through a phone camera. No contract, no exclusivity — and the model stated openly: Ecobraz is paid by the destination and recovery of the material, which is why the collection itself is free. The service is sold and performed in Brazil; the documentation is built to be read anywhere.

Who this page is for

  • Finance and the CFO — who approve on total cost, risk and written conditions, before any meeting;
  • Procurement and vendor onboarding — who screen suppliers out on documents alone and need those documents without booking a call;
  • IT and facilities — accountable for idle assets and for data still sitting on media, almost always against a deadline;
  • ESG and compliance — who answer the group questionnaire and need evidence from the Brazilian end of the chain.

What changes at scale

Multi-site operation

A programme designed around the units and regions served, with local and central owners, material categories and packaging standards agreed in writing — the design is detailed in recurring collections.

Planned recurrence

By calendar, by accumulated volume or on request per site: the model follows each operation’s geography, predictability and temporary storage capacity.

Documentation per collection

Photos and weights recorded at origin, inventory, the fiscal note (NF), waste transport manifest (MTR) and final destination certificate (CDF) where applicable, plus a certificate with a validatable QR code — organised in the client portal, free for every client, with an exportable history.

Conditions in the open, before any meeting

No contract, no exclusivity, no monthly fee — the conditions of each operation in writing, first. The history is exportable: the data belongs to your company. Specific services (technical reports, data sanitisation with a report, ESG reports) are priced separately, always with a written proposal. For standard collections: free within 1 to 7 business days, and express within 24 hours for R$ 55 (Brazilian reais). Multi-site, data centre and decommissioning work is quoted per project — timing and conditions go in the proposal.

When head office asks: Scope 3, CSRD and ESG documentation

Scope 3 in the global chain

The European CSRD directive requires companies in scope to report Scope 3 emissions — and the destination of electronics discarded in Brazil is part of that chain. The evidence is created collection by collection.

Contractable ESG documentation

For when the report has to go further than what already comes free: three formats — Brazilian standard, European standard (with Villanova ESG) and reports for banks, boards and shareholders.

How it starts

  1. Describe the operation

    Sites, materials, approximate volume and the documentary requirement — as it reached you from the audit, head office or the buyer.

  2. Technical assessment

    The team replies within 24 business hours, in English or Portuguese, with scope and conditions in writing. Nothing is confirmed before that.

  3. First documented collection

    Pick-up with photos, weights and inventory recorded at origin — free collection within 1 to 7 business days when the material and volume qualify.

  4. Recurring programme and portal

    The flow becomes a multi-site programme, and the documents for each collection sit organised in the free portal, with an exportable history.

Prefer to check the documentation before talking?

Nothing decisive sits behind a meeting: see how the proof is built in documentation and traceability and the public records in public evidence. Qualification documents are provided on request — reply within 24 business hours.

Frequently asked questions

Do you serve operations outside São Paulo?

Regular operations cover São Paulo and the surrounding region; corporate operations in other Brazilian regions are assessed case by case, according to size, logistics and deadlines.

Is a contract or exclusivity required?

No. There is no mandatory contract, monthly fee or exclusivity — not even for recurring programmes. The conditions of each operation are set in writing, and the evidence portal stays free for every client.

What is paid for?

Collection is free — Ecobraz is paid by the destination and recovery of the material. Express collection within 24 hours costs R$ 55. Specific services (technical reports, data sanitisation with a report, medical and laboratory equipment, ESG reports) are priced separately, with no public price, always with a written proposal before confirmation.

How does head office validate the evidence?

The destination certificate carries a QR code any auditor can check for authenticity, anywhere; the portal organises the documents per collection under the company’s Brazilian registration (CNPJ), with an exportable history — the check does not depend on Ecobraz.

Describe the operation — the answer comes in writing.

Sites, materials, volume and documentary requirement: the team replies with scope and conditions within 24 business hours, at no obligation.

html:
The European CSRD requires in-scope companies to report Scope 3 emissions — the value chain, not just their own operation. If your group runs or sources from an operation in Brazil, the destination of the electronics discarded here is part of that chain — and it needs evidence, not a generic statement. The service is performed in Brazil; the documentation is built for the auditor, wherever they sit.

Where disposal enters the value-chain report

What head office and the auditor ask for is not a promise of “sustainable disposal”: it is the trail connecting origin, inventory, movement, treatment and closure. Signs the requirement has already arrived — or is on its way:

  • Head office sent a supplier questionnaire with questions about waste and end of life;
  • A European buyer asked for evidence of destination and the improvised answer did not convince;
  • The bank or the client has started asking for chain evidence and data — and disposal is part of it;
  • Each due diligence round asks for more traceability than the one before.

What your company receives

Destination with evidence per collection

Photos and weights recorded at origin, inventory, NF, MTR and CDF where applicable and a destination certificate with a validatable QR code — the evidence is born in the operation, collection by collection.

Documents organised in the portal

The documents of each collection organised under the company’s registration, with an exportable history — the data series that feeds the value-chain report, in the format your ESG system uses.

Bridge to Villanova ESG

For the documentation control of the European market, the joint work with Villanova ESG structures the evidence into a dossier written for procurement, compliance and finance readers.

How it works

  1. Describe the operation and the requirement

    Sites in Brazil, materials, approximate volume and what head office or the buyer is asking for.

  2. Technical assessment

    The team assesses materials, locations and the applicable documentation. Terms are confirmed before anything is scheduled.

  3. Documented collection

    Removal with photos, weights and inventory recorded at origin; destination with the documents applicable to the material and the service performed.

  4. Evidence in the portal — and, if contracted, the dossier

    Documents organised per collection in the free portal. Structuring for the European market and the reports of contractable ESG documentation are separate services, with a written proposal.

Declared limits

Ecobraz does not issue certification and does not guarantee compliance with any norm or legislation: regulatory classification remains the responsibility of the company and the buyer. Carbon figures without independent validation are not presented as verified — an estimate is shown as an estimate.

Frequently asked questions

Does this guarantee CSRD compliance?

No. The CSRD requires in-scope companies to report Scope 3 emissions; documented disposal provides the evidence for the Brazilian end of that chain. Regulatory classification and the reporting itself remain the company’s responsibility.

Which documents make up the evidence?

Per collection: photos and weights recorded at origin, inventory, NF, MTR and CDF where applicable and a destination certificate with a validatable QR code. The set reflects the service actually performed.

And when head office asks for the European format?

The joint work with Villanova ESG structures the evidence into a dossier for procurement, compliance and finance readers — a separately contracted service, with a written proposal.

Is the portal paid?

No. The portal is free for every client, with no contract — access is enabled with the registered e-mail.

Head office’s next due diligence already has a date. Is your evidence ready?

Describe the operation in Brazil and the requirement received — the team replies with scope, terms and the applicable documentation, in writing.

Every Ecobraz client already receives documented disposal free of charge: a destination certificate with a validatable QR code, documents per collection and the evidence portal. When the report has to go further — a group audit, a European head office, a bank, a board — there is contractable ESG documentation: a separately priced service, in three report formats, always with a written proposal first. The service is sold and performed in Brazil; the documentation is built to be read anywhere.

What is already free, with no contract

A destination certificate with a validatable QR code, NF, MTR and CDF where applicable, photos and weights per collection and an exportable history in the portal — for every client, with access via the registered e-mail. See the detail in documentation and traceability and the records on the public evidence page.

Three report formats

The same set of operational records, organised for three different readers — because a Brazilian auditor, a European buyer and a credit committee do not ask for the report in the same shape.

Brazilian standard

Reports structured from the records of the operation in Brazil — inventory, NF, MTR and CDF where applicable, photos and weights per collection and chain of custody — for accountability, audit and internal reporting.

European standard

Evidence organised for Brazil–Europe chains, with the documentation control of Villanova ESG: a structured dossier written for procurement, compliance and finance readers — including the input for the Scope 3 reporting the European CSRD requires from in-scope companies.

For banks, boards and shareholders

Reports for the people who answer to committees, credit and governance: the same base of records, presented for decision-level reading — every figure with its source, scope and date.

How the service is contracted

  1. Describe the purpose

    Who will read the report — an auditor, head office, a bank, a board — and the requirement exactly as it arrived.

  2. Assessment

    We map what the operation already generates, what the requirement asks for and what still needs structuring.

  3. Written proposal

    Scope, deliverables, timescales and terms presented before anything is confirmed. Priced separately, with no published price list — and never mandatory.

  4. Delivery

    Reports in the contracted format, built from the records of the operation — reflecting what was actually performed.

Declared limits

We do not issue certification, seals or regulatory approval; carbon figures without independent validation are presented as estimates; the documentation does not replace a third-party audit — it arrives ready for one. Public records and the limits of each claim are listed on the public evidence page.

Frequently asked questions

Is the ESG documentation free?

No. Documented disposal, the QR certificate and the portal are free for every client. ESG documentation is a separately contracted service, with a written proposal and terms before confirmation.

Does it replace our audit?

No. The documentation arrives ready for the audit; the auditing is done by the auditor. Estimates are shown as estimates, and every claim carries its source, scope and date.

Do you issue a certification or a seal?

No. The service organises records and reports of the operation actually performed — certifications and acceptance depend on the buyer, the bank or the scheme applicable to each case.

Which records feed the reports?

The operation’s own: photos and weights per collection, inventory, NF, MTR and CDF where applicable, chain of custody and the exportable history in the portal.

Which report does your company have to deliver?

Describe the purpose and who will read it — the team replies with an assessment and a written proposal, with no obligation.

html:
Operação com muitas unidades, comitê que decide em conjunto e auditoria que pede prova — não promessa. A Ecobraz atende grandes empresas e multinacionais com descarte documentado em escala: programa multissite, recorrência planejada e documento por coleta, com certificado cuja autenticidade qualquer auditor confere em segundos pela câmera. Sem contrato, sem exclusividade — e com o modelo declarado: a Ecobraz se remunera com a destinação e a valorização do material, por isso não cobra pela coleta.

Para quem é esta página

  • Financeiro e CFO — que aprovam com custo total, risco e condições por escrito, antes de qualquer reunião;
  • Compras e homologação — que eliminam fornecedor na triagem documental e precisam dos documentos sem pedir reunião;
  • TI e facilities — que respondem por ativos parados e por dados em mídias, quase sempre com prazo;
  • ESG e compliance — que respondem à matriz e precisam de evidência da ponta brasileira da cadeia.

O que muda na escala grande

Operação multissite

Programa desenhado por unidades e regiões atendidas, com responsáveis locais e centralizadores, categorias de materiais e padrão de acondicionamento definidos por escrito — o desenho está detalhado em coletas recorrentes.

Recorrência planejada

Calendário, volume acumulado ou solicitação por unidade: o modelo segue a dispersão geográfica, a previsibilidade e a capacidade de armazenamento temporário de cada operação.

Documentação por coleta

Fotos e pesos registrados na origem, inventário, NF, MTR e CDF quando aplicáveis e certificado de destinação com QR code validável — organizados no sistema de rastreabilidade, gratuito para todo cliente, com histórico exportável.

Condições às claras, antes de qualquer reunião

Sem contrato, sem exclusividade, sem mensalidade — as condições de cada operação por escrito, antes. O histórico é exportável: os dados são da sua empresa. Serviços específicos (laudos, sanitização de dados com laudo, relatórios ESG) são pagos à parte, sempre com proposta por escrito. Para coletas padrão: gratuita em 1 a 7 dias úteis e expressa em até 24h por R$ 55. Operações multissite, data center e desmobilizações são orçadas por projeto — prazo e condições vão na proposta.

Quando a matriz pergunta: Escopo 3, CSRD e documentação ESG

Escopo 3 na cadeia global

A diretiva europeia CSRD exige das empresas alcançadas o relato das emissões de Escopo 3 — e o destino dos eletrônicos descartados no Brasil faz parte dessa cadeia. A evidência nasce coleta a coleta.

Documentação ESG contratável

Quando o relatório precisa ir além do que já vem grátis: três recortes — padrão brasileiro, padrão europeu (com a Villanova ESG) e relatórios para instituições bancárias, conselhos e acionistas.

Como começa

  1. Descreva a operação

    Unidades, materiais, volume aproximado e a exigência documental — como ela chegou da auditoria, da matriz ou do comprador.

  2. Avaliação técnica

    A equipe retorna em até 24h úteis com escopo e condições por escrito. Nada é confirmado antes disso.

  3. Primeira coleta documentada

    Retirada com fotos, pesos e inventário registrados na origem — coleta gratuita em 1 a 7 dias úteis quando o material e o volume se enquadram.

  4. Programa recorrente e portal

    O fluxo vira programa multissite, e os documentos de cada coleta ficam organizados no portal gratuito, com histórico exportável.

Prefere validar a documentação antes de conversar?

Nenhuma informação decisiva fica atrás de reunião: veja como a prova é construída em documentação e rastreabilidade, o que o sistema entrega em sistema de rastreabilidade e os registros públicos em evidências públicas. Documentos de habilitação são fornecidos mediante solicitação — resposta em até 24h úteis.

Perguntas frequentes

Atendem operações fora de São Paulo?

A atuação regular é em São Paulo e região; operações corporativas em outras regiões do Brasil são avaliadas caso a caso, conforme porte, logística e prazos.

Precisa de contrato ou exclusividade?

Não. Não há contrato obrigatório, mensalidade nem exclusividade — mesmo em programas recorrentes. As condições de cada operação são definidas por escrito, e o portal de evidências continua gratuito para todo cliente.

O que é pago?

A coleta é gratuita — a Ecobraz se remunera com a destinação e a valorização do material. A expressa em até 24h custa R$ 55. Serviços específicos (laudos, sanitização de dados com laudo, equipamentos médicos/laboratoriais, relatórios ESG) são pagos à parte, sem preço público, com proposta por escrito antes da confirmação.

Como a matriz valida a evidência?

O certificado de destinação tem QR code cuja autenticidade qualquer auditor confere, em qualquer lugar; o portal organiza os documentos por coleta no CNPJ da empresa, com histórico exportável — a conferência não depende da Ecobraz.

html:
A diretiva europeia CSRD exige das empresas alcançadas o relato das emissões de Escopo 3 — a cadeia de valor, e não apenas a operação própria. Para multinacionais e exportadoras com operação no Brasil, o destino dos eletrônicos descartados aqui faz parte dessa cadeia — e precisa de evidência, não de declaração genérica.

Onde o descarte entra no relato da cadeia global

O que a matriz e o auditor pedem não é uma promessa de “descarte sustentável”: é a trilha que conecta origem, inventário, movimentação, tratamento e encerramento. Sinais de que a exigência já chegou — ou está a caminho:

  • A matriz enviou questionário de fornecedor com perguntas sobre resíduos e fim de vida;
  • O comprador europeu pediu evidência de destinação e a resposta improvisada não convenceu;
  • O banco ou o cliente começou a pedir evidências e dados da cadeia — e o descarte é parte disso;
  • Cada rodada de due diligence pede mais rastreabilidade que a anterior.

O que a sua empresa recebe

Destinação com evidência por coleta

Fotos e pesos registrados na origem, inventário, NF, MTR e CDF quando aplicáveis e certificado de destinação com QR code validável — a evidência nasce na operação, coleta a coleta.

Documentação organizada no portal

Os documentos de cada coleta organizados no CNPJ da empresa, com histórico exportável — a série de dados que alimenta o relato da cadeia, no formato que o seu sistema de ESG usa.

Ponte com a Villanova ESG

Para o controle documentacional do mercado europeu, a atuação conjunta com a Villanova ESG estrutura a evidência em dossiê para leitura de procurement, compliance e finanças.

Como funciona

  1. Descreva a operação e a exigência

    Unidades no Brasil, materiais, volume aproximado e o que a matriz ou o comprador pede.

  2. Avaliação técnica

    A equipe avalia materiais, localidades e a documentação aplicável. As condições são confirmadas antes do agendamento.

  3. Coleta documentada

    Retirada com fotos, pesos e inventário registrados na origem; destinação com os documentos aplicáveis ao material e ao serviço executado.

  4. Evidência no portal — e, se contratado, o dossiê

    Documentos organizados por coleta no portal gratuito. A estruturação para o mercado europeu e os relatórios da documentação ESG contratável são serviços à parte, com proposta por escrito.

Limites declarados

A Ecobraz não emite certificação nem garante conformidade com norma ou legislação: o enquadramento regulatório é responsabilidade da empresa e do comprador. Números de carbono sem validação independente não são apresentados como verificados — estimativa aparece como estimativa.

Perguntas frequentes

Isso garante a conformidade com a CSRD?

Não. A diretiva CSRD exige das empresas alcançadas o relato das emissões de Escopo 3; o descarte documentado fornece a evidência da ponta brasileira dessa cadeia. O enquadramento regulatório e o relato são responsabilidade da empresa.

Que documentos compõem a evidência?

Por coleta: fotos e pesos registrados na origem, inventário, NF, MTR e CDF quando aplicáveis e certificado de destinação com QR code validável. O conjunto reflete o serviço efetivamente executado.

E quando a matriz pede o formato europeu?

A atuação conjunta com a Villanova ESG estrutura a evidência em dossiê para leitura de procurement, compliance e finanças — serviço contratado à parte, com proposta por escrito.

O portal é pago?

Não. O portal é gratuito para todo cliente, sem contrato — o acesso é liberado com o e-mail cadastrado.

A próxima due diligence da matriz já tem data. A sua evidência está pronta?

Descreva a operação no Brasil e a exigência recebida — a equipe retorna com escopo, condições e a documentação aplicável, por escrito.

html:
Todo cliente da Ecobraz já recebe o descarte documentado grátis: certificado com QR code validável, documentos por coleta e portal. Quando o relatório precisa ir além — auditoria, matriz europeia, banco, conselho — existe a documentação ESG contratável: um serviço pago à parte, em três recortes, sempre com proposta por escrito.

O que já vem grátis, sem contrato

Certificado de destinação com QR code validável, NF, MTR e CDF quando aplicáveis, fotos e pesos por coleta e histórico exportável no portal — para todo cliente, com login pelo e-mail cadastrado. Veja o detalhe em documentação e rastreabilidade e no sistema de rastreabilidade.

Três recortes de documentação contratável

O mesmo conjunto de registros da operação, organizado para três leitores diferentes — porque auditor brasileiro, comprador europeu e comitê de crédito não pedem o relatório no mesmo formato.

Padrão brasileiro

Relatórios estruturados a partir dos registros da operação no Brasil — inventário, NF, MTR e CDF quando aplicáveis, fotos e pesos por coleta e cadeia de custódia — para prestação de contas, auditoria e relato interno.

Padrão europeu

Evidência organizada para cadeias Brasil–Europa, com o controle documentacional da Villanova ESG: dossiê estruturado para leitura de procurement, compliance e finanças — incluindo a composição do relato de Escopo 3 exigido pela diretiva CSRD das empresas alcançadas.

Para instituições bancárias, conselhos e acionistas

Relatórios para quem responde a comitês, crédito e governança: a mesma base de registros, apresentada para leitura de decisão — cada número com fonte, escopo e data.

Como contratar

  1. Descreva a finalidade

    Quem vai ler o relatório — auditoria, matriz, banco, conselho — e a exigência como ela chegou.

  2. Diagnóstico

    Mapeamos o que a operação já gera, o que a exigência pede e o que falta estruturar.

  3. Proposta por escrito

    Escopo, entregáveis, prazos e condições apresentados antes da confirmação. Serviço cobrado à parte, sem preço público — e nunca obrigatório.

  4. Entrega

    Relatórios no recorte contratado, a partir dos registros da operação — refletindo o que foi efetivamente executado.

Limites declarados

Não emitimos certificação, selo ou aprovação regulatória; números de carbono sem validação independente aparecem como estimativa; a documentação não substitui a auditoria de terceira parte — ela sai pronta para a auditoria. Registros públicos e limites de cada alegação estão nas evidências públicas.

Perguntas frequentes

A documentação ESG é gratuita?

Não. O descarte documentado, o certificado com QR e o portal são grátis para todo cliente. A documentação ESG é um serviço contratado à parte, com proposta e condições por escrito antes da confirmação.

Isso substitui a auditoria da empresa?

Não. A documentação sai pronta para a auditoria; quem audita é o auditor. Estimativas aparecem como estimativas, e cada alegação tem fonte, escopo e data.

Vocês emitem certificação ou selo?

Não. O serviço organiza registros e relatórios da operação executada — certificações e aceites dependem do comprador, do banco ou do esquema aplicável a cada caso.

Que registros alimentam os relatórios?

Os da própria operação: fotos e pesos por coleta, inventário, NF, MTR e CDF quando aplicáveis, cadeia de custódia e o histórico exportável do portal.

Qual relatório a sua empresa precisa entregar?

Descreva a finalidade e quem vai ler — a equipe retorna com o diagnóstico e a proposta por escrito, sem compromisso.

title: Órgãos públicos — parceria e contratação
custom_excerpt: Coleta e destinação documentada de resíduos eletrônicos para órgãos públicos: parceria (Lei 13.019/2014) ou contratação (Lei 14.133/2021), sem exclusividade e sem custo ao erário no modelo regular.
meta_title: Órgãos públicos: parceria e contratação | Ecobraz
meta_description: Coleta e destinação documentada para órgãos públicos: parceria (Lei 13.019) ou contratação (Lei 14.133), sem exclusividade. Resposta em 24h úteis.
html:
A Ecobraz realiza coleta e destinação de resíduos eletrônicos com registro documental por etapa, e atende órgãos públicos, prefeituras, autarquias e conselhos profissionais. É uma associação civil constituída em 2011 (CNPJ 14.197.457/0001-42). No modelo regular, a operação não gera custo ao erário: a Ecobraz se remunera com a destinação e a valorização do material — por isso não cobra pela coleta. Esta página resume, sem retórica comercial, os dois caminhos jurídicos possíveis, o que o órgão recebe e como iniciar.

Dois caminhos jurídicos, separados desde o início

Parceria e contratação são regimes distintos e não se misturam. A escolha depende do que o órgão pretende — e quem define a via, no caso concreto, é sempre o próprio órgão, com sua assessoria jurídica.

Parceria — Lei 13.019/2014 (MROSC)

Para o ente que busca uma parceria sem contraprestação financeira: destinar bens inservíveis do próprio órgão ou atuar em conjunto em ações de coleta e educação ambiental no território. Os instrumentos usuais são o termo de fomento, o termo de colaboração ou o termo de doação, conforme o desenho de cada caso.

Em palavras simples: o órgão não paga pelo serviço e não contrata — formaliza uma parceria ou uma doação.

Contratação — Lei 14.133/2021

Para o órgão cujo processo interno exige licitar ou contratar formalmente o serviço de destinação dos próprios resíduos. Nesse regime, a modalidade e as hipóteses aplicáveis são definidas pelo órgão, com sua procuradoria, no caso concreto.

Em palavras simples: quando a regra da casa pede contrato, o caminho é a lei de licitações.
Em qualquer dos dois regimes

A equipe da Ecobraz fornece os documentos e as informações necessários à instrução do processo.

O que o órgão recebe

  • Coleta documentada — registro por etapa, da retirada à destinação final.
  • Certificado de destinação com QR code de validação, conferível pelo setor de controle interno ou por auditoria.
  • Documentos por coleta — inventário do material retirado e, quando aplicáveis ao material e ao serviço executado, MTR e CDF.
  • Portal de acompanhamento gratuito, com acesso ao histórico das coletas do órgão.
Não exigimos exclusividade

O órgão não assina contrato de exclusividade: pode manter outros fornecedores, programas e cooperativas em paralelo, sem qualquer restrição da nossa parte.

Precedente verificável

Em 20/08/2021, a Ecobraz firmou com o Conselho Regional de Biologia da 1ª Região (CRBio-01) o Termo de Doação nº 01/2021, no processo administrativo CRBio-01 nº 303/2021, com extrato publicado no Diário Oficial da União. Citamos este registro exatamente pelo que ele comprova: instrumento formalizado com ente da administração pública, com publicação em imprensa oficial — fonte que qualquer setor jurídico pode conferir.

Habilitação e documentos

A documentação de habilitação é fornecida mediante solicitação, no formato que o instrumento exigir — cada processo pede um conjunto próprio, e é a solicitação do órgão que define o que enviar. Solicite o dossiê pelo formulário ou pelo e-mail institucional contato@ecobraz.org.br, indicando o órgão e o tipo de processo (parceria ou contratação).

Todo documento é enviado com data e validade identificadas — nada é apresentado como vigente sem estar.

Como iniciar

Pelo formulário

Preencha o formulário de agendamento e mencione o nome do órgão no campo de descrição.

Por canal institucional

Ofícios, diligências e solicitações formais pelo e-mail contato@ecobraz.org.br ou pelo telefone (11) 4329-2001.

Prazo de resposta

Resposta em até 24h úteis. Visitas técnicas à operação podem ser agendadas.

html:
Where to dispose of fridges, washing machines and household appliances

Old household appliances are bulky and may contain circuit boards, motors, cables, oils, gases, batteries and other components. The collection option available depends on the address, the volume, the condition of the equipment and the handling conditions on site.

Items that can be assessed

  • Fridges, freezers, minibars and water dispensers;
  • Washing machines, tumble dryers and dishwashers;
  • Microwaves, ovens and small appliances;
  • Televisions, audio equipment and household electronics;
  • Air-conditioning and climate-control equipment, subject to specific analysis.

What to include in your request

Provide the quantity, photos, address, floor, lift access, stairs, parking and whether the equipment is intact. Do not remove gases, compressors or components yourself.

Frequently asked questions

Is collection free of charge?

There is no single answer. Feasibility and costs vary according to location, item, quantity, access and the operation required.

Do you collect broken washing machines?

Send us the address and photos so we can check which option is available in your region.

Contact us to arrange appliance collection

Where to dispose of an old or broken washing machine

Washing machines combine a metal frame, motor, circuit boards, cables, plastics and components that can be recovered or routed for treatment. Because they are heavy and bulky, removal needs to take the route to the vehicle into account.

Equipment that can be assessed

  • Automatic and semi-automatic washing machines;
  • Tumble dryers, twin tubs and spin dryers;
  • Dishwashers and laundry equipment;
  • Residential, commercial and industrial machines.

Prepare the information

Send photos, the approximate model, quantity, address, floor, lift, stairs and any time restrictions. Also let us know whether the equipment is disconnected and drained of water.

Frequently asked questions

Do you collect a single machine?

Feasibility depends on the location and the operational route. Contact us so we can assess the alternative available for your case.

Does an industrial machine follow the same process?

Industrial equipment requires weight, dimensions, rating plate, access conditions and any handling resources to be confirmed before a proposal is issued.

Contact us about washing machine collection

Old TVs should not go into general waste

CRT, LCD, LED and plasma televisions contain glass, circuit boards, cables, metals and components that require proper end-of-life treatment. Broken screens also call for additional care during packaging and transport.

Items that can be included in a request

  • CRT, LCD, LED and plasma TVs;
  • Computer monitors and professional displays;
  • Projectors, audio systems and video equipment;
  • Remote controls, cables, power supplies and accessories.

What to tell us

Describe the screen technology, approximate size, quantity, condition of the screens, address and access conditions. Do not break up or dismantle the equipment to reduce its volume.

Frequently asked questions

Do you collect CRT televisions?

Each item can be assessed according to location, quantity, condition and logistics.

Can a broken screen be collected?

Let us know about this condition and send photos. Packaging must protect people and prevent fragments from dispersing.

Contact us to request a TV and monitor assessment

html:
Networks and telecommunications combine assets, data and infrastructure

Exchanges, switches, routers, radios and transmission equipment may hold configurations, credentials, modules, batteries and components installed in controlled-access locations. Removal must take account of inventory, shutdown, dismantling and handling.

Assets for assessment

  • Telephone exchanges, IP handsets and gateways;
  • Switches, routers, firewalls and appliances;
  • Radios, antennas, repeaters and transmission equipment;
  • Racks, patch panels, power supplies, modules and cabling;
  • Equipment from carriers, service providers, data centres and corporate networks.

Planning the collection

Tell us the models, quantities, location, weight, installation height, any dismantling required and whether sensitive data or configurations are present. Work at height, technical areas and energised sites call for a specific assessment.

Frequently asked questions

Does the collection include removing installed antennas?

Not automatically. Dismantling, work at height and technical access must be set out in the scope and may require specialised resources.

Can assets be inventoried by serial number?

Yes, when requested and approved before the operation.

Contact us to request a telecoms assessment

html:
Ecobraz Emigre publishes original technical reports on the governance, evidence and final destination of post-use electrical and electronic assets. Each report is deposited on Zenodo — an open research repository operated by CERN — and receives a DOI (Digital Object Identifier), a persistent identifier that ensures the document can be located and cited in a stable way, today and in the future.

These are technical and conceptual works authored by Marcio Villanova (ORCID 0009-0001-8072-6287), version 1.0, not submitted to peer review. They do not replace the legal, environmental or technical assessment applicable to each specific case — and it is precisely this transparency about scope and limits that also guides our operation.

Published reports

1. Post-Use Electrical and Electronic Assets as Corporate Risk: Environmental, Asset and Information Governance

Proposes a conceptual matrix of post-use exposure across the environmental, asset, information and evidential dimensions — distinguishing retirement from use, asset write-off, physical removal, data treatment and environmental destination as separate events, each with its own responsible parties and its own evidence.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Ativos Eletroeletrônicos Pós-Uso como Risco Corporativo: Governança Ambiental, Patrimonial e Informacional. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21397950 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

2. Asset Write-Off Does Not End the Risk: Responsibilities and Evidence in IT Asset Decommissioning

Shows why a write-off in the fixed-asset register does not, on its own, prove physical removal, transfer of custody, data treatment or environmental destination — and proposes the Post-Use Closure Vector to track each closure state separately.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. A Baixa Patrimonial Não Encerra o Risco: Responsabilidades e Evidências no Descomissionamento de Ativos de TI. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398130 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

3. Residual Data Risk in Decommissioned Equipment: Media Governance, Sanitisation and Accountability

Relates the duties under the LGPD (Brazil's data protection law), the guidance issued by the ANPD and the NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 2 technical reference, and proposes the Residual Information Risk Matrix to decide the appropriate treatment for each type of media — without assuming that a single technique suits every case.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Risco Residual de Dados em Equipamentos Desativados: Governança de Mídias, Sanitização e Prestação de Contas. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398306 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

4. Chain of Custody for Electronic Waste: Integrity, Continuity and Traceability of Evidence

A conceptual chain-of-custody architecture — the ability to maintain a reconstructable link between object, custodian, event, time and evidence — with terminology grounded in ISO 22095 and an analysis of the distinct documentary functions of the MTR (waste transport manifest) and the CDF (final destination certificate).

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Cadeia de Custódia de Resíduos Eletroeletrônicos: Integridade, Continuidade e Rastreabilidade da Evidência. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398390 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

5. From Collection to Final Destination: What Each Stage Can Support — and What It Cannot

Starts from the principle of minimal assertion: a request is not a booking, a booking is not a collection, a collection is not receipt, and an MTR is not a CDF. Proposes the Evidential Scope Matrix by Stage, linking each record to the fact it actually supports.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Da Coleta à Destinação: O que Cada Etapa Pode Sustentar - e o que Não Sustenta. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398750 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

6. Evidence of Environmental Destination: Scope and Limits of Documents, Records and Certificates in Isolation

Examines what collection, transport, receipt and destination documents can prove on their own, and proposes the Evidential Sufficiency Matrix — seven qualitative tests to assess the issuer, object, scope and consistency of each record.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Evidência de Destinação Ambiental: Alcance e Limites de Documentos, Registros e Certificados Isolados. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398814 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

7. Qualifying Reverse Logistics Providers: Risk-Based Due Diligence for Procurement, Compliance and Audit

A risk-based due diligence framework for qualifying and monitoring providers of removal, transport, treatment and final destination — showing why a licence, a price, a contract or a certificate in isolation does not demonstrate all the competence required for a specific scope.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Qualificação de Prestadores de Logística Reversa: Due Diligence Baseada em Risco para Compras, Compliance e Auditoria. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398879 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

8. Multi-Site Reverse Logistics: Controls for Distributed Corporate Operations

Governance for operations that remove electrical and electronic assets from multiple sites, cities or states: how to balance corporate standards with local conditions while keeping inventories, providers and evidence reconcilable with one another.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Logística Reversa Multissite: Controles para Operações Corporativas Distribuídas. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398926 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

9. Non-Conformities in the Destination of Electronics: A Taxonomy for Audit and Corporate Control

A taxonomy with six finding states for recording and handling documentary discrepancies without going beyond the available facts — separating immediate correction, root-cause analysis, corrective action and closure verification.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Não Conformidades na Destinação de Eletroeletrônicos: Uma Taxonomia para Auditoria e Controle Corporativo. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21398989 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

10. Indicators Without Evidence: The Limits of Weight, Volume and Recycling Percentages in Corporate Accountability

Examines why weight, volume and percentages can appear precise and still be insufficient for accountability purposes. Proposes the Waste Indicator Identity Sheet and distinguishes measured, calculated, estimated, declared and verified values.

How to cite: VILLANOVA, Marcio. Indicadores sem Evidência: Limites de Peso, Volume e Percentuais de Reciclagem na Prestação de Contas Corporativa. Zenodo, 2026. doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21399040 (open-access PDF, in Portuguese).

Use and reproduction

The PDFs are available in open access on each DOI page. To cite them in papers, proposals or internal policies, use the format indicated for each report. Questions about the topics covered can be sent by email to contato@ecobraz.org.br or through the Ecobraz channels.

See also the public evidence of our operation and the author profile of Marcio Villanova.

html:
Data centre decommissioning demands planning

Servers, storage arrays, switches, routers, racks and power units concentrate weight, data and operational dependencies. Collection must be planned around the inventory, the shutdown window, site access and the security controls required.

Assets covered

  • Rack, tower and blade servers;
  • Storage arrays, appliances, tape libraries and tapes;
  • Switches, routers, firewalls and telecoms equipment;
  • Racks, rails, PDUs, UPS units and cabling;
  • HDDs, SSDs and other removable media.

Critical points of the operation

  • Weight, dimensions, lifts, loading docks and access restrictions;
  • Asset identification and reconciliation against the inventory;
  • Segregation of media and definition of the data treatment;
  • Chain of custody and named owners for each handover;
  • A schedule compatible with business continuity.

Frequently asked questions

Does the team dismantle racks and infrastructure?

This requirement should be described for technical assessment. The proposal sets out what is and is not included.

Can media be tracked separately?

Yes, when provided for in the scope. State the quantity, the technology and the evidence required.

Contact us about your data centre assessment

Evidence your head office can verify

Every client uses the Ecobraz evidence portal free of charge — no contract, no monthly fee, no exclusivity. Each collection generates photos and weights recorded at origin, the applicable fiscal and transport documents (NF, MTR) and, where applicable, a final destination certificate (CDF) with a QR code that any auditor, anywhere, can check for authenticity in seconds. Records are organised per collection and exportable, so a compliance team at head office can verify the Brazilian operation without leaving its desk. The team replies within 24 business hours — request a collection or book a demonstration.

Reverse logistics is an operation, not just transport

An efficient flow connects generation, storage, consolidation, collection, checking, treatment and evidence. The design should take into account materials, risks, distances, frequency, responsibilities and the data needed for management.

Possible scopes

  • Pick-up at head office, branches, shops or customer sites;
  • Regional consolidation of small volumes;
  • Internal campaigns or permanent programmes;
  • Decommissioning of IT assets;
  • Flows for technical repair, exchanges and post-consumer returns;
  • Integration with inventory and operational records.

Decisions before roll-out

  1. Define which materials the programme covers.
  2. Map generation points and expected volumes.
  3. Establish packaging, labelling and responsible staff.
  4. Choose the collection trigger and the level of traceability.
  5. Define how exceptions and non-conforming items are handled.

Useful indicators

Volume by category and site, time to collection, non-conformity rate, reconciled assets and completed documents help keep the process under control. Indicators should reflect data that is actually collected.

When a one-off collection is not enough

Organisations with multiple sites, ongoing asset refresh cycles or frequent maintenance need a repeatable process. Recurring collections reduce accumulation, standardise requests and improve visibility over materials and documents.

Programme elements

  • Sites and regions covered;
  • Accepted material categories;
  • Minimum volume, frequency or collection trigger;
  • Local and central points of contact;
  • Packaging and labelling standards;
  • Data, inventory and documentation requirements;
  • Reports and indicators consistent with the scope.

Operating models

The programme can be based on a calendar, accumulated volume or per-site requests. The design depends on geographic spread, predictability, criticality and temporary storage capacity.

Who it is for

Retail chains, education networks, hospitals and clinics, manufacturing sites, offices, multi-tenant buildings, repair and service centres, data centres and organisations with multiple points of generation.

Frequently asked questions

Is a contract required?

No. There is no mandatory contract, monthly fee or exclusivity — even for recurring programmes. Operating and documentation terms are set out in writing for each programme, and the evidence portal remains free for every client.

Do all sites need to generate the same volume?

No. The plan can group locations and set different criteria, provided the flow remains operationally viable.

html:
Cut-off date for this page: 26 July 2026. Each item below presents the fact, the official source and the exact limit of what the evidence proves. Nothing beyond the verifiable is claimed.

Principles adopted

Authority does not come from absolute promises. It depends on clear scope, identified responsibilities, consistent records and documents that represent the materials, the stages and the service actually performed. What exists is shown; what is pending is flagged; what cannot be proven is never turned into a promise.

Public records and listings for Ecobraz

European Union — good practice listed on the ECESP

Ecobraz's Adopt a Neighbourhood programme (Adote um Bairro) is listed as a good practice on the European Circular Economy Stakeholder Platform (ECESP), a joint initiative of the European Commission and the EESC. Listing is visibility, not endorsement. See the official listing. What this does not mean: approval, certification or any seal of the European Union.

United Nations — profile in the civil society database

Ecobraz is listed in the United Nations iCSO database — the UN's civil society participation database — under code 708794; a listing, not an endorsement. Open the UN database (code 708794). What this does not mean: affiliation, accreditation or partnership with the UN, nor ECOSOC consultative status.

World Bank — citation in an infoDev report

Ecobraz was cited in an infoDev/World Bank Group study on models and scaling conditions in green sectors (“Innovations for Scaling Green Sectors”, 2017), in the section dedicated to electronic waste management. See the report. What this does not mean: recommendation, certification, funding or partnership with the World Bank.

Brazil — founded in 2011

Ecobraz is a Brazilian civil society organisation (CNPJ 14.197.457/0001-42), founded in 2011. Transparency note (corrected on 26 July 2026): a publication in the Diário Oficial da União (Brazil's official gazette) of 21 July 2023 (item no. 1,355, case no. 08071.000426/2023-36) records the granting of the OSCIP qualification requested by the entity. A previous version of this page mistakenly cited an item and case number belonging to another entity published in the same edition of the gazette — the error has been identified and corrected. Confirmation of the current status in the Ministry of Justice register is under way; until that confirmation, Ecobraz does not use the qualification in commercial materials.

Chronology note: Ecobraz was founded in 2011 (15 years of operation in 2026). External references to “16 years of experience” — such as the listing on the European platform — refer to the founding team's track record in the sector prior to the organisation's formal constitution.

CETEM — REMINARE operators register

Ecobraz/Emigre declares that it is included in the register of REMINARE operators maintained by the Centre for Mineral Technology (CETEM). Direct public verification pending: the official page renders the list dynamically and may not show the name in a plain-text reading; until a directly verifiable record is published, this evidence is classified as pending. See the listing. What this does not mean: a licence, certification or official approval.

Technical publications by Marcio Villanova

Marcio Villanova, CEO of Ecobraz and founder of Villanova ESG, maintains a public author identity under ORCID 0009-0001-8072-6287 and technical reports with persistent identifiers (DOIs) deposited on Zenodo, covering supplier evidence, financial risk, buyer-readiness, Brazil–Europe supply chains and corporate IT disposal. The 7 publications:

  • The EU-Brazil Supplier Evidence Gap: Operational Traceability, Buyer-Readable Documentation and Regulatory Defensibility — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20293223
  • EU-Brazil Supplier Evidence Gap: A Technical Report on Regulatory Defensibility, Buyer-Readiness and Audit-Grade Documentation — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20317248
  • Audit-Grade Evidence as a Financial Risk Control in EU-Brazil Supply Chains — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20319388
  • Market Access Is Not Compliance: The EU-Brazil Supplier Evidence Gap under CSDDD, CBAM, EUDR and the EU-Mercosur Agreement — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20346263
  • The Evidence Compression Risk: Why EU Regulatory Simplification May Increase Supplier Pressure for Brazilian Exporters — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20371672
  • Regulatory Clarity Is Not Audit-Grade Evidence: Supplier Evidence Architecture, Circular Value Chains and EU-Brazil Buyer-Readiness — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20448487
  • From Corporate E-Waste Disposal to Audit-Grade Evidence: Secure Collection, Data Sanitisation, Environmental Traceability and Avoided CO2e Documentation in Brazil — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20814645

Note: the first report also carries the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20293222, which aggregates all versions and does not constitute an additional publication. There are 7 distinct publications.

Marcio Villanova is registered in the expert database of the European Commission’s Funding & Tenders Portal under number EX2026D1439124. Registration does not mean selection, contracting, appointment or endorsement by the European Commission. About the expert database.

The technical work of Marcio Villanova and Villanova ESG has public entries on the European Circular Economy Stakeholder Platform, including the circular supply chain evidence toolkit for non-EU suppliers and the position paper on the EU–Mercosur agreement. These listings are visibility, not endorsement. Note: ORCID is a self-managed persistent identifier, and deposit on Zenodo does not constitute peer review or institutional endorsement.

Social impact — Projeto Reciclando

Technically reusable equipment is directed to reuse and digital inclusion through Projeto Reciclando. Aggregate operational figures (collections, clients, tonnes) will be published only after reconciliation with primary records, together with the methodology and a cut-off date — no aggregate figure is disclosed before that.

What an organisation should verify before engaging a provider

Confirm who performs each stage, which materials are accepted, where each party's responsibility ends, which evidence will be delivered and which exceptions may prevent the operation. An inventory, a collection record, a chain of custody, a processing report and proofs of final destination serve different purposes — the requirement should be stated before the proposal.

Commitment to verifiable information

Institutional and technical content distinguishes legal obligation, good practice, operational capability and commercial conditions. Where an answer depends on the material or the location, Ecobraz will indicate the need for a technical assessment.

Contact us by email to request an operation with a documented scope

html:
Last updated: 12 July 2026.

1. Controller and contact

Associação Auxílio à Reciclagem de Eletrônicos e Inclusão Digital – Ecobraz, registered under Brazilian CNPJ 14.197.457/0001-42, is responsible for the decisions concerning the processing of personal data described in this policy. Requests may be sent to contato@ecobraz.org.br.

2. Data collected

The collection request form may record name, company, e-mail address, telephone number, the address or postcode of the operation, city, state, materials, volume, documentation requirements, timescale, referring page and campaign parameters. Technical data such as IP address, browser and access logs may be processed for security, diagnostics and measurement.

3. Purposes

  • Assessing the request and verifying whether the collection is feasible;
  • Making contact, preparing a proposal and organising the operation;
  • Recording the enquiry in our sales system;
  • Preventing abuse, fraud and security failures;
  • Measuring the performance of the website and of campaigns;
  • Sending marketing communications only where authorisation or another applicable legal basis exists.

4. Sharing and processors

Data may be processed by suppliers required for hosting, security, customer service, CRM, automation and communication. The form feeds requests into Ploomes. Where the data subject ticks the communications option, their contact details may also be sent to E-goi. These suppliers receive only the data necessary for their respective purposes.

5. Legal bases and consent

Processing may take place for preliminary procedures related to the request, performance of a contract, compliance with obligations, the regular exercise of rights, assessed legitimate interest and consent, depending on the purpose. Marketing authorisation is optional and may be withdrawn.

6. Retention

Data are kept for the period necessary for handling the enquiry, the commercial relationship, legal obligations, dispute prevention and the protection of rights. They may subsequently be erased, anonymised or retained where an applicable legal ground exists.

7. Data subject rights

Data subjects may request confirmation of processing, access, rectification, information about data sharing and the other rights provided for in applicable legislation. Requests must allow the identity of the requester to be verified securely.

8. Cookies and metrics

The website may use essential technologies and measurement tools for operation, security and performance analysis. Browser settings can limit cookies, although some functions may be affected.

9. Security and updates

Ecobraz adopts technical and administrative measures proportionate to the processing. No environment is entirely immune to incidents. This policy may be updated to reflect operational, legal or technological changes, with the date of the current version indicated.

Cookies, measurement and consent

What we use: the website uses Google Analytics 4 to measure visits, traffic sources and interactions (such as button clicks and form submissions). These measurements use Google cookies and identifiers (tag G-Y1ERW8GNPR).

Consent mode: we apply Google Consent Mode v2. For visitors from the European Union, the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland, measurement starts switched off and is only enabled after acceptance in the cookie banner. For all other visitors, measurement starts enabled, with the option to decline available in the same banner.

Your choice: your decision (accept or decline) is stored in your browser and applies to subsequent visits. You can change it at any time via the Cookie preferences link in the footer of any page.

Heatmaps (Microsoft Clarity): we use Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors use the website (the areas most clicked, how far pages are scrolled and anonymised session replays), with the aim of improving the experience. Text typed into form fields is masked by default and the tool respects the same cookie-banner choice described above.

Ad conversion measurement: when the collection form is submitted, the e-mail address and telephone number provided may be transmitted to Google in encrypted (hashed) form, solely to identify which advert originated the enquiry (Google Ads enhanced conversions). This transfer respects the same cookie-banner choice described above: where cookies are declined, these data are not used.

What we do not do: we do not sell browsing data and we do not send marketing communications without your specific consent, which is given via a separate, optional checkbox when the request is submitted.

Printing equipment is also an electronic asset

Printers and multifunction devices combine circuit boards, motors, cables, plastics and metals. Some models store documents, usage histories or network credentials, which is why corporate disposal should also address data security.

Materials covered

  • Laser, inkjet, thermal and dot-matrix printers;
  • Multifunction devices, copiers, scanners and plotters;
  • Power supplies, cables, trays and accessories built into the equipment;
  • Batches of office equipment and print fleets.

What to include in your enquiry

Send us the models, quantities, photos and the collection address. Please also let us know if there are large or heavy units, restrictions on moving equipment, or internal storage that requires data sanitisation. Loose toner and ink cartridges are not covered by this service.

Frequently asked questions

Do you collect loose toner or ink cartridges?

No. The assessment on this page covers electronic printing equipment.

Do you remove heavy copiers?

Feasibility depends on weight, access, stairs, lifts and the resources required to move the equipment.

Contact us to arrange printer collection

Small devices concentrate data and components

Mobile phones and tablets can retain accounts, authentication credentials, files, personal data and corporate information even when they are broken or out of use. Preparation for disposal should include revoking access, taking inventory and defining how data will be treated.

Materials we handle

  • Mobile phones, smartphones, tablets and e-readers;
  • Telephones, switchboards, headsets and accessories;
  • Cameras, audio and video equipment;
  • Chargers, cables, power supplies and electronic accessories;

Recommended preparation

Where possible, remove accounts, SIM and memory cards and activation locks in line with your organisation's policy. Do not dispose of corporate devices without assessing data, mobile device management and the need for evidence.

Can a broken phone still contain data?

Yes. A failed screen or battery does not mean the stored content has been erased.

Do chargers need to be kept separate?

html:
How to dispose of an old fridge correctly

Fridges and freezers should not be abandoned on the street or dismantled without proper controls. They contain a compressor, oil, metals, plastics, electrical components and refrigerant gas. Collection depends on the address, the condition of the equipment and the handling conditions on site.

What to provide to receive an assessment

  • Postcode (CEP) and collection address;
  • Quantity and photos of the equipment;
  • Whether the fridge is intact or dismantled;
  • Floor, lift, stairs and distance to the vehicle;
  • Whether the request is residential or business.

Commercial refrigeration and large batches

Bars, restaurants, hotels, supermarkets and businesses can include freezers, display fridges, minibars and water dispensers in their request. Large volumes require planning for access, weight, crew and the collection window.

Frequently asked questions

Is collection free of charge?

Conditions vary according to location, quantity, condition and logistics. Your enquiry starts a technical assessment; it does not automatically confirm the collection or that it will be free of charge.

Can I remove the compressor beforehand?

We do not recommend dismantling the equipment or releasing refrigerant on your own. Send photos of its current condition and we will advise you.

Contact us to request a fridge collection assessment

Batteries, white goods and industry

html:
Disposing of an old fridge in São Paulo requires attention to environmental regulations and the use of appropriate collection channels to ensure safety and respect for the environment. Under federal legislation and state guidelines, it is essential to send the appliance to authorised facilities. Here is how to proceed with correct disposal.

Legislation Applicable to Fridge Disposal

Fridge disposal is governed by Law No. 12,305/2010 (the National Solid Waste Policy — PNRS), which sets out guidelines for the proper management of waste, including household appliances. In addition, CETESB, the environmental agency of the state of São Paulo, defines specific rules for the handling of equipment containing refrigerant gases and other hazardous components.

Precautions Required for Disposal

Older fridges contain components such as CFC refrigerant gas, which is harmful to the ozone layer. The removal and treatment of these gases must therefore be carried out by authorised specialist companies, as required by the National Solid Waste Management Information System (SINIR). Improper disposal can lead to fines and serious environmental impacts.

Disposal Locations and Options in São Paulo

Consumers can hand the appliance over at designated collection points or request collection through official channels. In the state capital, the city authorities maintain systems for the safe removal of large household appliances. It is advisable to arrange a documented electronic waste collection — contact Ecobraz by email — to ensure the appliance is routed correctly.

How to Book a Collection

For safe disposal, residents can book removal through the City of São Paulo's official urban collection service, under the conditions published by the municipality. On the official website, basic details and the equipment to be disposed of must be provided. The process includes transport to recycling or specialist treatment facilities, in accordance with the applicable rules.

Why Responsible Disposal Matters for Sustainability

The proper disposal of fridges prevents soil and water contamination by refrigerants and heavy metals. It also promotes the recycling of recoverable components, reducing the consumption of natural resources. Complying with current legislation protects the environment and contributes to the circular economy.

Secure Disposal of Data-Bearing Devices

If the fridge contains electronic components that store information, a secure media disposal process is recommended. This step supports the controlled elimination of data and reduces legal and privacy risks.

Informative content. Classifications, obligations, documents and operational conditions should be confirmed according to the material, the location and the legislation in force.

title: How Electronic Waste Collection Works
custom_excerpt: From the initial request to pick-up and final records: understand the stages used to assess and carry out an electronics collection.
meta_title: How Electronic Waste Collection Works | Ecobraz
meta_description: Learn how to request an electronics collection, what information to provide, and how logistics, treatment, traceability and documentation are defined.
codeinjection_head:

html:
1. Request

The process begins with objective information: the waste generator's profile, address, materials, estimated quantity or volume, photographs, access conditions and the expected timescale. The better the description, the more accurate the assessment.

2. Technical and logistical assessment

The team reviews the location, the composition of the batch, risks, packaging requirements, weight, handling, the operational window and the resources needed. Submitting the form does not automatically confirm the collection.

3. Scope definition

Before scheduling, the parties agree on accepted materials, responsibilities, site preparation, data handling, inventory, documentation, costs and timescales. Items outside the scope must be kept separate.

4. Scheduling the pick-up

Once approved, the operation is scheduled according to availability and site requirements. Organisations should provide access rules, loading docks, lifts, security clearance procedures and the contacts responsible for release.

5. Collection and transfer

Materials are checked according to the agreed method. Where contracted, the chain of custody records the responsible parties, volumes, assets or media at each planned transfer point.

6. Processing and records

Treatment and documentation vary according to the category, the approved service and the actual execution. Some records depend on verification or processing carried out after the pick-up.

What speeds up the assessment

  • General photographs and photographs of labels or rating plates;
  • Quantities per category;
  • Postcode and access conditions;
  • An asset spreadsheet, where available;
  • A clear description of the documents and data handling required.

Contact us to request a collection

Evidence your head office can verify

Every client uses the Ecobraz evidence portal free of charge — no contract, no monthly fee, no exclusivity. Each collection generates photos and weights recorded at origin, the applicable fiscal and transport documents (NF, MTR) and, where applicable, a final destination certificate (CDF) with a QR code that any auditor, anywhere, can check for authenticity in seconds. Records are organised per collection and exportable, so a compliance team at head office can verify the Brazilian operation without leaving its desk. The team replies within 24 business hours — request a collection or book a demonstration.

  • Monitors, pumps, diagnostic and laboratory equipment;

Infectious, chemical or radioactive waste, as well as unidentified materials, must not be mixed into the electronic batch. Acceptance depends on characterisation and on the approved scope.

Does Ecobraz issue asset write-offs?

No. Ecobraz does not collect equipment or waste with chemical, biological or radioactive contamination. Electronic hospital equipment only enters assessment upon a declaration of absence of contamination and the prior removal of radiation sources and controlled components by a qualified professional.
